title: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 remote code execution was possible via argument injection in Perforce…
description: A critical remote code execution vulnerability exists in JetBrains TeamCity versions before 2026.1.3 and 2025.11.7. The flaw arises from argument injection in Perforce settings, allowing an attacker with limited privileges to execute arbitrary code remotely without user interaction.
